data.name: Project President
data.detailed_description:
The presidency is not a game. It is the nation’s future.


Project President is a deep political strategy simulation where every law, crisis, speech and scandal reshapes the country you are trying to govern.

You inherit a nation under pressure: inflation, debt, crime, protests, fragile coalitions, hostile media, social unrest, institutional resistance and an opposition waiting for your government to collapse.

You are not only choosing policies.

You are managing power.

A living political system


Watch approval, inflation, unemployment, debt, poverty, crime, protests, polarization, scandals, governability and voter groups move as your decisions collide with the country.

The economy, Congress, the street, the media and the election are not separate screens. They are one connected political machine.

Pass laws or lose control


Push reforms, negotiate votes, respond to opposition bills and spend political capital carefully. A popular policy can fail in Congress. A necessary reform can destroy your coalition.

Survive crises


Banking panic. Mass protests. Crime waves. Hospital overload. Food insecurity. Corruption scandals. Institutional conflict. Assassination attempts.

Every crisis gives you options.

Every option creates enemies.

Control the narrative


Hold press conferences, speak to the public, react to social pressure and decide whether to calm the country, attack your rivals, deny the scandal or buy time.

The public is always watching.

Win elections or lose power


Campaigns are not decoration. Make promises, manage campaign funds, track polls, fight attacks, mobilize voter groups and survive the final stretch before election day.

Approval helps.

Strategy wins.

How far will you go?


Govern democratically, negotiate and absorb the pain.

Or abuse power, threaten opponents, manipulate institutions and hold the system together by force.

The country will react.
The election will judge you.
History will remember what you became.

FEATURE LIST - ENGLISH

  • Deep presidential strategy simulation focused on power, crisis and consequences.
  • Manage economy, budget, taxes, security, health, education, trade, diplomacy and institutions.
  • More than 600 political, social and economic events.
  • More than 300 laws and reforms with delayed consequences.
  • Persistent crisis situations that escalate or resolve over time.
  • Cabinet, Congress, opposition, media, courts, social groups and elections.
  • Campaign system with promises, polling, attacks, scandals and final-stretch pressure.
  • Playable countries with different economic and political starting conditions.
  • President creator with visual identity, biography and political profile.
  • Optional local AI features for dynamic political dialogue.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
